claims.text: The charge turns on POL-NS-01 limb (c): the driver must have held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force. The period in force on EV-TRIP-00851 is 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the longest qualifying in-geofence run on EV-GPS-00851 is 210 seconds — a margin of 30 seconds and no more. The export's first fix is stamped 18:10:00, the exact instant of the driver's pressed arrival marker, and every one of the 22 driver fixes sits at 0.0 m with speed 0, so the whole 210 seconds is evidenced only from the tap onward; no fix in the export places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius at any moment before it. Limb (c) is therefore met by the narrowest of margins on a single artifact and the judge should read it that way rather than as a comfortable arrival.

POL-NS-12 cannot supply the independent carrier that would corroborate arrival and the serving of the waiting period. It applies only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; on EV-TRIP-00851 the marker is BUTTON, so the platform's own arrival event and wait-timer events are not a record independent of the export, and POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) stand or fall on the exported trace alone. That matters here because the export opens at the arrival tap, so the platform has no second, independent measurement of the driver's position in the geofence before the tap.

POL-NS-02 admits an arrival only on at least three consecutive position fixes each reporting horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, and it ignores fixes whose reported accuracy is worse than 25 m. Not one fix in EV-GPS-00851 reports any accuracy figure at all, and the policy's own integrity table states that a fix with no reported horizontal accuracy is of UNKNOWN accuracy for POL-NS-02. The 25 m gate therefore could not be applied anywhere in this trace, and the derived count of 22 qualifying fixes cannot be read as a clean, accuracy-backed 150 m arrival; on that basis the arrival finding should be discounted under POL-GEN-02 rather than taken at full weight.

The rider does not dispute the rider's own track: EV-GPS-00851's rider_presence places the rider's device 667.17 m from the pickup pin on every one of its 22 fixes, with a rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius. That is why I do not press POL-NS-04 limb (c), which affirmatively fails, and why POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this record; the driver's arrival and dwell must be decided on the driver's own evidence under POL-NS-01. I put the point this way rather than stretching an inapplicable clause.

On the driver's side of the POL-NS-04 coordination ledger, limb (b) is met: the driver posted one message at 18:10:10, the rider answered at 18:10:30, and the driver then neither posted a reply within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty for the whole trip — so the rider's answer went unanswered and the driver fell silent for the remaining three minutes before terminating for a no-show. I cite that silence only as it bears on the fee's premise, which is compensation for a rider who failed to appear after contact: the record shows contact made and no further attempt to locate the rider before the fee was taken.

No traffic advisory is on file for this pickup road: EV-ADVIS-00851-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0. I disclose that weight. POL-NS-06 requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before limb (i) can allow dwell to be accumulated across separate in-geofence intervals, so limb (i) cannot be run at all here; no limb of POL-NS-06 may be asserted against the rider on the strength of an absent artifact, the required minimum is not reduced and the measured dwell is not extended, and the case stands or falls on the single 210-second run recorded on EV-GPS-00851.

The contested amount and the remedy: EV-FARE-00851 carries a cancellation-fee line of 4.50 charged at 18:13:35 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and 4.50 is the net figure the resolution rule produces for this trip. If the judge finds the effective in-geofence dwell shorter than the free waiting period in force, or any limb of POL-NS-01 unsatisfied, POL-NS-06 refunds that fee line in full. The rider asks for FULL_REFUND of the 4.50 and does not seek any booking, platform or other fee.

claims.text: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-00851 at 18:10:00, and the GPS trace independently places the driver inside the AIRPORT pickup geofence at that moment: 22 driver fixes qualify as in-radius against the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, and the arrival block records a dwell-start offset of 0.0 s from the first fix. POL-NS-01 limb (a) and limb (b) are therefore both carried on this record.

The driver's position was held continuously inside the geofence for 210 seconds, from 18:10:00 to 18:13:30, across a single unbroken run of 22 in-geofence fixes. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (the record carries it, so no default applies, and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null). The measured dwell exceeds the required minimum by 30 seconds.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the record states that no boarding event was recorded. The termination falls 30 seconds after the required 180 second dwell elapsed at 18:13:00, so limb (d) is satisfied on its own terms as well as on the clock.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05. At the 18:10:00 arrival timestamp the trace shows the driver stationary at the pin (max, min and mean distance 0.0 m) and the only distinct speed reading in the driver's track is 0 km/h, so neither of the clause's independent triggers - more than 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or above - fires, and the waiting clock is not disturbed.

No waiting-period shortfall arises under POL-NS-06: the in-geofence dwell of 210 seconds already meets the 180 second minimum, so the clause's refund route is not engaged. For completeness, the accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) could not be used on this record even if a shortfall existed, because its required traffic_advisory is MISSING: EV-ADVIS-00851-01 carries admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0, and the derived arrival block records that limb (i) is unavailable for exactly that reason. That impairment is disclosed here, and it does not touch the finding, which rests on the driver's own in-geofence run.

POL-NS-03 does not apply. The clause decides only trips where the driver was stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin. Here the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius - the derived driver track reports min, max and mean distance of 0.0 m from the pin - so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and the fee is not displaced by it.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and it fails on two independent limbs. Limb (a) requires a rider message during the waiting window whose content is locating or coordinating - the rider's own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that she cannot see the vehicle. The rider's only message, sent 18:10:30, reads 'I cannot get there in time'; that is an admission of non-arrival, not any of the enumerated locating or coordinating contents. Limb (c) then fails affirmatively: the rider's track places her device 667.17 m from the pickup pin, far outside the 200 m rider presence radius for AIRPORT, with zero qualifying rider fixes across the waiting window. The rider was not at the pickup point, and on that track the clause has no application at all.

The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 does not trip, so the driver's compensation is payable rather than withheld. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the count of 4 the clause requires, and the rate limb fails too: 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 100 is 0.01, below the 0.08 threshold. Both limbs must hold and neither does. On the net cancellation fee in force for the trip, SGD 4.50, the driver's 80 percent share is SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare breakdown's money block reports as driver_compensation under POL-NS-07.

There is no fare-integrity defect to discount the fee under POL-NS-08(d). The fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line is SGD 4.50, which reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so the line equals the net amount the resolution rule produces for this trip and the fee stands unreduced.

No escalation trigger is engaged. There is no contradiction between carriers - the trip record's arrival event at 18:10:00 and the GPS in-geofence run from 18:10:00 to 18:13:30 agree to the second, so POL-NS-09(b) is not reached; both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so limb (c) is not reached; and the deciding facts are carried by two COMPLETE, weight-1.0 artifacts, so limb (e) is not reached. The declining-by-escalation route is not available on this record.

The disposition of the fee and the ruling value are two different things here. The rider filed this dispute and the fare breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so no refund is supported and the charge stands as it presently is - NO_ACTION is party-relative and, on these facts, favourable to the driver. But because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, the clause from which the money flows is POL-NS-07, and the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd rather than any sum refunded to the rider.

ruling.explanation:
The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands as charged, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

All four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-00851 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:10:00. (b) EV-GPS-00851 places the driver at the pickup pin (0.0 m) at 18:10:00, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius that applies to trip_record.pickup_zone_class AIRPORT. (c) the driver's in-geofence run is continuous for 210 seconds, 18:10:00 to 18:13:30, exceeding the 180 second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which the record carries; platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null). (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 with RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) names, with no boarding event — 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:13:00.

The rider's arguments. (i) The dwell clears the minimum by only 30 seconds and no fix predates the arrival tap: accepted, and read that way — but POL-NS-06 refunds only where the dwell is shorter than the free period, and 210 > 180, so no shortfall arises and its refund route is not engaged. (ii) No fix in EV-GPS-00851 reports a horizontal accuracy, so the 25 m gate could not be applied: the policy answers this — a fix with no reported accuracy is of UNKNOWN accuracy and is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter; it does not impair EV-GPS-00851 (weight 1.0, no admissibility issues) and does not cap confidence, and at 0.0 m from the pin the arrival sits inside the 150 m radius on any plausible error. (iii) POL-NS-12 cannot supply an independent platform-measured carrier because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO: accepted, and it costs no finding, because the exported trace itself carries arrival and dwell at full weight.

POL-NS-04 does not help the rider: limb (a) fails (the 18:10:30 message 'I cannot get there in time' is an admission of non-arrival, not the locating or coordinating content the limb enumerates) and limb (c) fails affirmatively (rider device 667.17 m from the pin, 0 qualifying rider fixes against the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius). POL-NS-03 does not apply (driver inside the arrival radius). POL-NS-05 does not fire (driver stationary at 0.0 m, sole speed 0 km/h). POL-NS-08(d) shows no fare defect: the 4.50 cancellation line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50.

POL-NS-09 is not engaged: the trip record's arrival event and the GPS run agree to the second, both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, and the deciding facts rest on weight-1.0 artifacts.

POL-NS-07: the anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (< 4) and 1/100 = 0.01 (< 0.08) — so the driver's 80 percent share of the 4.50 fee is payable, SGD 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-00851's money block reports. The rider's fee is left in place (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Because this ruling moves money to the driver, the value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors the 3.60 rather than any refund to the rider. The monetary effect, 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

One claim was discarded on the mechanical check and is recorded below: the rider's traffic-advisory claim, which relied on the MISSING EV-ADVIS-00851-01 without naming its issue code.

ruling.explanation: Both parties: the rider's challenge to the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee on EV-FARE-00851 is not supported, the charge stands as it presently is, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60. The fee is chargeable because all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on EV-TRIP-00851 and EV-GPS-00851. Limb (a): the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 18:10:00. Limb (b): the exported trace opens at 18:10:00 with the driver stationary at 0.0 m from the Changi T3 pickup pin, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, so the driver is in the geofence at the timestamp of that event. Limb (c): measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (18:10:00) and not from the tap, the driver held position without moving for 210 seconds, to cancellation at 18:13:30 — exceeding the 180-second free waiting period in force, which the record itself carries (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30, 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:13:00, under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event recorded. Because the fee stands and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, which is the figure EV-FARE-00851's money block reports as driver_compensation; the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the count of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 100 = 0.01, below the rate of 0.08), so compensation is paid rather than held. Per POL-GEN-03, because the driver is owed money the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors the SGD 3.60 figure; this is the amount the ruling moves, not a second payment, and it is not a refund to the rider. On the rider's specific points: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider because limb (a) fails — 'I cannot get there in time' is an admission of non-arrival, not any of the locating or coordinating contents the clause enumerates — and limb (c) fails affirmatively, the rider's track sitting 667.17 m from the pin with 0 qualifying rider fixes against the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius; the driver's silence after the rider's 18:10:30 message therefore buys the rider nothing, as POL-NS-04 requires all three limbs together. POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the arrival radius (0.0 m), not outside it. POL-NS-05 does not disturb the clock: at 18:10:00 the trace shows the driver at 0.0 m and the only speed reading is 0 km/h, so neither trigger (over 300 m, or 15 km/h or more) fires. POL-NS-06 gives no refund because there is no shortfall — 210 seconds against a 180-second minimum. On the rider's POL-NS-12 point, the advocate is correct that the arrival marker is BUTTON and not GPS_AUTO, so the platform's own events are no independent carrier; the arrival and the dwell are nonetheless established by the exported trace itself, and limb (b) is met at the event's timestamp, not merely before it. On the accuracy point, EV-GPS-00851 was admitted as COMPLETE with no issue codes at weight_multiplier 1.0, and the integrity block treats a fix with no reported horizontal accuracy as of unknown accuracy, neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter; that neither impairs the trace under any limb of POL-NS-08 nor lowers the POL-GEN-02 cap, so the arrival finding is not discounted. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: the trip record and the trace agree to the second on arrival and termination, both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the deciding facts rest on COMPLETE weight-1.0 artifacts. Confidence is therefore set at 0.90 (the deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 cap is 1.0), above the 0.70 platform floor read from the policy. The disputed amount is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the SGD 3.60 payment executes automatically on issue unless appealed.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged on EV-FARE-00851 stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs and each is met. (a) EV-TRIP-00851 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 18:10:00. (b) EV-GPS-00851 places the driver at 0.0 m from the pickup pin — inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius — from 18:10:00, the exact arrival timestamp, so the arrival marker is also not false under POL-NS-05 (stationary at the pin, max/min/mean distance 0.0 m, speed 0 km/h; neither the 300 m nor the 15 km/h trigger fires). (c) The driver held position continuously for 210 seconds (18:10:00 to 18:13:30) against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds, read from EV-TRIP-00851 platform_policy.free_wait_sec — the record carries it, so no default applies, and no_show_threshold_sec is null. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, 30 seconds after the 180-second dwell elapsed, and the record shows no boarding event.

Nothing displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not beyond it. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the rider's only message ('I cannot get there in time', 18:10:30, EV-CHAT-00851) is an admission that she was not coming, not the locating or coordinating content limb (a) requires, and limb (c) fails affirmatively — EV-GPS-00851's rider track places the rider's device 667.17 m from the pin, far outside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, with 0 qualifying rider fixes. POL-NS-06 is not engaged: the measured dwell of 210 seconds exceeds the 180 second minimum, so there is no shortfall.

Driver compensation. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80 percent of the net fee: 0.80 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-00851's money block reports as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the count of 4) and 1 / 100 = 0.01 (below 0.08); both limbs must hold and neither does. Under POL-GEN-03 a ruling that pays the driver is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.60, and the rider's charge stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

On the arguments that survived the citation check. (1) The argument that EV-GPS-00851 reports no horizontal accuracy and so the arrival cannot be read at full weight is rejected: absence of a reported accuracy figure is not one of the POL-NS-08(a)-(d) impairments, the integrity block directs that such a fix is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter, and the pre-pass graded EV-GPS-00851 COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issues — the derived block reports 22 in-radius fixes and the 210 second run, and I do not recompute that geometry. (2) The argument that POL-NS-12 cannot supply an independent carrier is accepted as far as it goes — the arrival marker is BUTTON, so that clause does not apply — but it does not change the outcome, because limb (b) is established by the driver's own in-geofence fixes and needs no second carrier. (3) The point that the driver fell silent after the rider's reply is noted; it bears on POL-NS-04(b), which concerns whether the rider is exonerated, and the rider's message was in any event an admission of non-arrival rather than a coordinating message. (4) The argument that the absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00851-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) prevents any accumulation of dwell is answered: the clause's accumulation route was never needed, since the single in-geofence run already meets the minimum; that claim was discarded at the citation stage and is not reinstated.

Confidence and routing. The deciding facts — arrival and dwell — are carried by EV-GPS-00851 and EV-TRIP-00851, both COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and the rider's own admission in EV-CHAT-00851 (weight 1.0) corroborates non-appearance, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; confidence is set at 0.85. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is not engaged: the trip record and GPS trace agree to the second (no POL-NS-09(b) conflict), both counterparty-dispute counters are 0 (no limb (c)), the anti-farming check does not trip and no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (no limb (d)), and no artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a)-(d) (no limb (e)). The monetary effect is SGD 3.60, at or below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this ruling executes automatically. No clause of the policy in force produces a referral on these facts.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on EV-FARE-00851 stands, and the driver is paid the SGD 3.60 share that POL-NS-07 fixes for it. This is a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling; amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd, because on such a ruling the figure is the money the case moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the filing party. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue unless either party appeals under POL-GEN-04.

WHY THE FEE IS CHARGEABLE. POL-NS-01 needs four things and each is on the record. (a) EV-TRIP-00851 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 18:10:00. (b) EV-GPS-00851 places the driver inside the Changi T3 (AIRPORT, 150 m) pickup geofence at that same timestamp — all 22 driver fixes sit 0.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h, so the arrival is not merely at the marker but at the pin. (c) The driver then held position continuously for 210 seconds, 18:10:00 to 18:13:30, against the 180-second free waiting period in force (read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 under RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:13:00, and the record states no boarding event. POL-NS-05 does not disturb the clock: at 18:10:00 the trace shows the driver stationary at the pin, and the only speed reading is 0 km/h, so neither trigger (over 300 m, or 15 km/h) fires and the marker is not false. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee: POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it; POL-NS-04 does not apply (below); POL-NS-05 does not apply; and POL-NS-06 is not engaged because the measured dwell (210 s) meets the minimum (180 s).

THE RIDER'S POINTS, ANSWERED. The rider's first point — that limb (c) is met by the narrowest margin, on a single run — is accepted as arithmetic but does not assist the rider: a 30-second margin is still a margin, and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (offset 0.0 s), not from the tap. The rider's second point — that POL-NS-12 cannot supply an independent platform measurement because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO — is accepted; POL-NS-12 does not apply, and it makes no difference, because limbs (b) and (c) are carried on the exported trace itself. The rider's third point — that no fix reports horizontal accuracy, so POL-NS-02's 25 m gate could not be applied and the arrival should be discounted under POL-GEN-02 — is rejected. POL-NS-01 limb (b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the POL-NS-02 geofence (the 150 m radius), which it does; the integrity block states that a fix with no reported accuracy is of UNKNOWN accuracy and is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter, so the arrival test is not affirmatively failed, and nothing in the record contradicts the arrival and dwell. The trace is COMPLETE, 100 percent coverage, 22 fixes at a 10-second cadence, max gap 10 s, rider_track present — it meets none of the POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) and is not impaired for policy purposes. The discount the rider asks for does not change any limb, any amount or any ruling. The rider's fourth and fifth points — on POL-NS-04 — are accepted in the driver's favour: limb (a) fails because 'I cannot get there in time' is an admission of non-arrival, not one of the locating or coordinating contents POL-NS-04(a) enumerates, and limb (c) fails affirmatively, the rider's device sitting 667.17 m from the pin with zero qualifying rider fixes against the 200 m AIRPORT radius. Because limbs (a) and (c) fail, the driver's silence after 18:10:30 (limb (b)) cannot make POL-NS-04 exonerate the rider, and it does not bear on chargeability. The rider's sixth point — that POL-NS-06 refunds the fee if any limb fails — is rejected because no limb fails and no shortfall arises.

THE DRIVER'S POINTS. The driver's limbs are accepted: POL-NS-01 (a) to (d) hold, POL-NS-05 does not fire, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-04 do not apply, and POL-NS-08(d) shows no fare defect — the EV-FARE-00851 cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 reconciles exactly with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (the clause needs 4 or more) and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 100 is 0.01 (the clause needs above 0.08); both limbs must hold and neither does, so compensation is payable, not withheld. On the net fee of SGD 4.50 the 80 percent share is SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare breakdown's money block reports.

NO ESCALATION, NO REFERRAL. No POL-NS-09 trigger is reached: the two carriers agree to the second on arrival and dwell, so there is no contradiction; both counterparty-dispute counters are 0; the deciding facts rest on COMPLETE weight-1.0 artifacts, not on impaired evidence; and confidence is well above the 0.70 floor. EV-ADVIS-00851-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact here and is named only so the disclosure is on the record — POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not needed because the single unbroken run already meets the minimum. No clause produces a referral, so the referrals array is empty.

ledger.claim: The charge turns on POL-NS-01 limb (c): the driver must have held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force. The period in force on EV-TRIP-00851 is 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the longest qualifying in-geofence run on EV-GPS-00851 is 210 seconds — a margin of 30 seconds and no more. The export's first fix is stamped 18:10:00, the exact instant of the driver's pressed arrival marker, and every one of the 22 driver fixes sits at 0.0 m with speed 0, so the whole 210 seconds is evidenced only from the tap onward; no fix in the export places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius at any moment before it. Limb (c) is therefore met by the narrowest of margins on a single artifact and the judge should read it that way rather than as a comfortable arrival.

POL-NS-12 cannot supply the independent carrier that would corroborate arrival and the serving of the waiting period. It applies only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; on EV-TRIP-00851 the marker is BUTTON, so the platform's own arrival event and wait-timer events are not a record independent of the export, and POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) stand or fall on the exported trace alone. That matters here because the export opens at the arrival tap, so the platform has no second, independent measurement of the driver's position in the geofence before the tap.

POL-NS-02 admits an arrival only on at least three consecutive position fixes each reporting horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, and it ignores fixes whose reported accuracy is worse than 25 m. Not one fix in EV-GPS-00851 reports any accuracy figure at all, and the policy's own integrity table states that a fix with no reported horizontal accuracy is of UNKNOWN accuracy for POL-NS-02. The 25 m gate therefore could not be applied anywhere in this trace, and the derived count of 22 qualifying fixes cannot be read as a clean, accuracy-backed 150 m arrival; on that basis the arrival finding should be discounted under POL-GEN-02 rather than taken at full weight.

The rider does not dispute the rider's own track: EV-GPS-00851's rider_presence places the rider's device 667.17 m from the pickup pin on every one of its 22 fixes, with a rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius. That is why I do not press POL-NS-04 limb (c), which affirmatively fails, and why POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this record; the driver's arrival and dwell must be decided on the driver's own evidence under POL-NS-01. I put the point this way rather than stretching an inapplicable clause.

On the driver's side of the POL-NS-04 coordination ledger, limb (b) is met: the driver posted one message at 18:10:10, the rider answered at 18:10:30, and the driver then neither posted a reply within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty for the whole trip — so the rider's answer went unanswered and the driver fell silent for the remaining three minutes before terminating for a no-show. I cite that silence only as it bears on the fee's premise, which is compensation for a rider who failed to appear after contact: the record shows contact made and no further attempt to locate the rider before the fee was taken.

No traffic advisory is on file for this pickup road: EV-ADVIS-00851-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0. I disclose that weight. POL-NS-06 requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated before limb (i) can allow dwell to be accumulated across separate in-geofence intervals, so limb (i) cannot be run at all here; no limb of POL-NS-06 may be asserted against the rider on the strength of an absent artifact, the required minimum is not reduced and the measured dwell is not extended, and the case stands or falls on the single 210-second run recorded on EV-GPS-00851.

ledger.claim: The contested amount and the remedy: EV-FARE-00851 carries a cancellation-fee line of 4.50 charged at 18:13:35 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and 4.50 is the net figure the resolution rule produces for this trip. If the judge finds the effective in-geofence dwell shorter than the free waiting period in force, or any limb of POL-NS-01 unsatisfied, POL-NS-06 refunds that fee line in full. The rider asks for FULL_REFUND of the 4.50 and does not seek any booking, platform or other fee.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-00851 at 18:10:00, and the GPS trace independently places the driver inside the AIRPORT pickup geofence at that moment: 22 driver fixes qualify as in-radius against the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, and the arrival block records a dwell-start offset of 0.0 s from the first fix. POL-NS-01 limb (a) and limb (b) are therefore both carried on this record.

The driver's position was held continuously inside the geofence for 210 seconds, from 18:10:00 to 18:13:30, across a single unbroken run of 22 in-geofence fixes. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (the record carries it, so no default applies, and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null). The measured dwell exceeds the required minimum by 30 seconds.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the record states that no boarding event was recorded. The termination falls 30 seconds after the required 180 second dwell elapsed at 18:13:00, so limb (d) is satisfied on its own terms as well as on the clock.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05. At the 18:10:00 arrival timestamp the trace shows the driver stationary at the pin (max, min and mean distance 0.0 m) and the only distinct speed reading in the driver's track is 0 km/h, so neither of the clause's independent triggers - more than 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or above - fires, and the waiting clock is not disturbed.

No waiting-period shortfall arises under POL-NS-06: the in-geofence dwell of 210 seconds already meets the 180 second minimum, so the clause's refund route is not engaged. For completeness, the accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) could not be used on this record even if a shortfall existed, because its required traffic_advisory is MISSING: EV-ADVIS-00851-01 carries admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0, and the derived arrival block records that limb (i) is unavailable for exactly that reason. That impairment is disclosed here, and it does not touch the finding, which rests on the driver's own in-geofence run.

POL-NS-03 does not apply. The clause decides only trips where the driver was stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin. Here the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius - the derived driver track reports min, max and mean distance of 0.0 m from the pin - so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and the fee is not displaced by it.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and it fails on two independent limbs. Limb (a) requires a rider message during the waiting window whose content is locating or coordinating - the rider's own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that she cannot see the vehicle. The rider's only message, sent 18:10:30, reads 'I cannot get there in time'; that is an admission of non-arrival, not any of the enumerated locating or coordinating contents. Limb (c) then fails affirmatively: the rider's track places her device 667.17 m from the pickup pin, far outside the 200 m rider presence radius for AIRPORT, with zero qualifying rider fixes across the waiting window. The rider was not at the pickup point, and on that track the clause has no application at all.

The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 does not trip, so the driver's compensation is payable rather than withheld. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the count of 4 the clause requires, and the rate limb fails too: 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 100 is 0.01, below the 0.08 threshold. Both limbs must hold and neither does. On the net cancellation fee in force for the trip, SGD 4.50, the driver's 80 percent share is SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare breakdown's money block reports as driver_compensation under POL-NS-07.

There is no fare-integrity defect to discount the fee under POL-NS-08(d). The fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line is SGD 4.50, which reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so the line equals the net amount the resolution rule produces for this trip and the fee stands unreduced.

No escalation trigger is engaged. There is no contradiction between carriers - the trip record's arrival event at 18:10:00 and the GPS in-geofence run from 18:10:00 to 18:13:30 agree to the second, so POL-NS-09(b) is not reached; both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so limb (c) is not reached; and the deciding facts are carried by two COMPLETE, weight-1.0 artifacts, so limb (e) is not reached. The declining-by-escalation route is not available on this record.

The disposition of the fee and the ruling value are two different things here. The rider filed this dispute and the fare breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so no refund is supported and the charge stands as it presently is - NO_ACTION is party-relative and, on these facts, favourable to the driver. But because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, the clause from which the money flows is POL-NS-07, and the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd rather than any sum refunded to the rider.
